 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable

The equipment must be fully isolated mechanically and electrically.
Remove the motor together with the semi coupling.
Remove the semi coupling from motor.
Extract the other semi coupling and V- ring.
Unscrew adjusting ring nut and remove washer.

Remove the oil distribution plate and oil beater plate thus freeing the 
 bearings.
Remove the space coupling and lantern.

Unscrew the nut and remove the gland and extract the packing and unscrew the 
 packing sleeve from the shaft.
Disconnect all main and auxiliary connection pipes.
Unscrew the nut of baseplate and extract the pump from the tank.
Set the pump on wooden supports on the floor.
Unscrew the nuts and extract the suction body.
Extract the impeller and diffuses and intermediate body and the sleeve.
Continue until the complete disassembly of the pump.
Reassembly by performing the above reverse order.
Check the condition of slide bearings.
Check the condition of thrust bearing.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the minor maintenance 
procedure P1, 
which must be performed every four years or 40.000 operation hours bases as indicated in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed El-Sabagh & eng. Adel Saad Zaghlool, 
 revised by eng. Mohamed selim & eng. Sobhy Abel Halim, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Mohamed Abd Elghaffar, and approved by Al Aresh PS Head Sector 
 eng. 
 The internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, safety shoes.
The equipment must be fully isolated mechanically and electrically.
Empty the pump completely.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Lifting ropes, Wooden blocks.
Cleaning fluids, Dial indicator.
Filler gauge, Rages.
Straight edge.

 bearing | 2 | Imported
Spacer | 6 | Local

Shaft | 2 | Local

Packing 8x8 mm |  | Local

 bearing |  | Local 
 workshop
Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly
Remove the motor together with the semi coupling.
Remove the semi coupling from motor.
Extract the other semi coupling and V- ring.
Unscrew adjusting ring nut and remove washer.
Remove the oil distribution plate and oil beater plate thus freeing the 
 bearings.
Remove the space coupling and lantern.
Unscrew the nut and remove the gland and extract the packing and unscrew the 
 packing sleeve from the shaft.
Disconnect all main and auxiliary connection pipes.
Unscrew the nut of baseplate and extract the pump from the tank.
Set the pump on wooden supports on the floor.
Remove the lubricator pipe.
Unscrew the nuts and extract the suction body.
Extract the impeller and diffuses and intermediate body and the sleeve.
Continue until the complete disassembly of the pump.
Reassembly by performing the above reverse order.
Checks before Reassembly
Check clearance of impeller.
Check the condition of slide bearings.
Check the condition of shafts.
Check the condition of thrust bearing.
After Reassembly when the 
Pump operates
Check the vibration.
Check the pressure and quantity of discharge according to characteristic
Check the motor ampere.
Check the temperature of oil.
Check the abnormal noise.

sections_ar.text: يوضح هذا المستند إجراء الصيانة الصغرى P1، الذي يجب تنفيذه كل أربع سنوات أو كل 40.000 ساعة تشغيل طبقًا لما هو موضح بجدول العنوان

أعدّ المسودة الأولى المهندس أحمد الصباغ والمهندس عادل سعد زغلول، وراجعها المهندس محمد سليم والمهندس صبحي عبد الحليم، وقبلها مدير عام المهندس محمد عبد الغفار، واعتمدها رئيس قطاع محطة العريش، بمساعدة المهندس محمد سليم.
يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة،
يلزم إقامة سياج أمان (حبل) وعلامات تحذير حول منطقة العمل.

items: يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة،
يلزم إقامة سياج أمان (حبل) وعلامات تحذير حول منطقة العمل.
يجب عزل المعدة تمامًا ميكانيكيًا وكهربيًا.
استخرج نصف القارنة الآخر وحلقة V.
فك صامولة حلقة الضبط وانزع الوردة.
انزع صفيحة توزيع الزيت وصفيحة خفق الزيت وبذلك تحرر الكراسي.
فك الصامولة وانزع الغدة واستخرج الحشو وفك جلبة الحشو من العمود.
افصل جميع مواسير التوصيل الرئيسية والمساعدة.
فك صامولة قاعدة التثبيت واستخرج الطلمبة من الخزان.
ضع الطلمبة على دعامات خشبية على الأرض.
استخرج الريشة والناشرات والجسم الوسيط والجلبة.
أعد التجميع بتنفيذ ما سبق بالترتيب العكسي.
